Trust & safety

Built for security engagements

HackersDeal combines marketplace flexibility with controls enterprises expect for offensive security work.

Escrow-backed payments

Client funds are held in ledger escrow until work is accepted. Disputes can trigger admin-reviewed refunds.

KYC for payouts

Researchers verify identity before withdrawing earnings, reducing fraud and chargeback risk.

Scoped security work

Projects define assets, in/out of scope, and testing windows — built for pentests, not generic gigs.

Dispute resolution

Threaded disputes with evidence uploads and admin triage, including escrow reversal when appropriate.

Payments via Razorpay (INR). Platform fees apply on escrow release. Admin tools cover KYC, disputes, and email templates.
